data.narrative:
Starfish Space is a Series B-stage space & aerospace company that has raised $100M+. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, Skyryse) and six public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL, and one additional).

Two quantitative methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $100M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implies a $190M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the five same-sector private comparables yields a $1.5B implied valuation, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring was not applied due to the absence of revenue data for the target. The public sector median trades at 23.9x price-to-sales across six tickers, but cannot be meaningfully applied without Starfish Space's disclosed revenue.

The triangulated valuation range is $162M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $845M. The wide dispersion reflects tension between the stage-progression method and peer multiples, reflecting material heterogeneity in the peer set. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the $100M raised as a valuation proxy versus disclosed post-money terms, and whether Starfish Space's specific technology and market position justify positioning toward the peer median or the lower-stage trajectory.
